about.privacyText: This plugin is completely private. All of your design data is processed locally in your browser and never leaves your computer. No analytics, no data collection, no tracking.
about.openSourceText: Figma to Code is completely open-source. Contributions, bug reports, and feature requests are welcome!
about.featureConvert: Convert Figma designs to HTML, Tailwind, Flutter, SwiftUI, and React Native
about.featureExtract: Extract colors and gradients from your designs
about.featureResponsive: Get responsive code that matches your design
about.contactText: Have feedback, questions, or need help? Open a GitHub issue:
about.debugText: Having an issue? Help me debug by copying the JSON of your selected elements. This can be attached when reporting issues.
about.oldVersionText: The new version is up to 100x faster, but might still cause some issues. If you encounter problems, you can switch to the old version (and please report issues so they can be fixed).
